testcase.name: Scenario: Show and hides the Layout panel during sketch editing: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-panel-visibility-source/features/application/ribbon-panel-visibility/ribbon-panel-visibility.feature:654:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Show and hides the Layout panel during sketch editing ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/planar-sketch-empty-xy.opd` is open with Sketch1 being edited ✔ And the Sketch tab is active ✔ And the Layout panel is hidden ✔ When the user opens the Create panel title context menu ✔ And the user opens Show Panels ✔ Then Layout is unchecked in the panel list ✔ When the user selects Layout ✔ Then the Layout panel appears between Constrain and Insert ✔ And Make Part and Make Components are disabled ✔ And Create Block is enabled ✔ When the user opens the Create panel title context menu ✔ And the user opens Show Panels ✔ And the user selects Layout ✔ Then the Layout panel is hidden again ✔ And the other visible Sketch panels remain in place ✔ And the sketch remains in edit mode
